Carla: Noted. Obs team: watch p95, p99, and token gen error rate. Dash: https://dash.redwood/rollouts/r-1762345678
Alice: Pinned config: model_binding: { service: "llm-gen", model_version: "3.2.1" } Added release notes link in the PR.

Dmitri: Thresholds: if 5xx >0.5% for 3m OR p95 delta >100ms for 5m -> stop. Anyone object to auto-stop config?
Bob: ack. Also add rollback-trigger on "malloc: insufficient memory" and "kv cache OOM" to be safe. :thumbsup:
monitor-bot: ALERT r-1762345678: 5xx rate = 1.2% (2m window). Top error: "malloc failed: insufficient memory" on infra-pool-a-12. See logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/r-1762345678

deploy-bot: Rollout STOP requested by @Carla. Executing rollback steps:
```
route set /generate -> version=3.2.0
scale deployment llm-gen-v3.2.1 --replicas=0
drain node infra-pool-a-12
```
Dmitri: Confirming rollback. Will open follow-up triage for kv-cache memory regression and model allocation path. Thanks for quick stop.
Alice: Updating release notes: "Rollback: canary v3.2.1 stopped due to memory regression on kv-cache. Reverting to v3.2.0." Adding changelog tag: rollback, infra.
Dmitri: Postmortem owners assigned: @Carla, @Eva. Quick sync scheduled 2026-03-22 22:30 UTC to review heap profiles and deployment knobs. :calendar:
Carla: 22:30 works. I'll capture telemetry snapshots (heap, kv cache hitrate, pod memory) and share before the call.
